rows.note: Use 車 as the all-purpose spoken noun for a conveyance or vehicle.

example.english: This vehicle can carry the whole family.
example.traditional: 呢架車可以載晒成家人。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaa3 ce1 ho2 ji5 zoi3 saai3 sing4 gaa1 jan4

rows.note: Use 車輛 mainly in formal or traffic-related contexts when referring to vehicles collectively or individually.

example.english: The police will inspect every vehicle at the checkpoint.
example.traditional: 警方會喺檢查站檢查所有車輛。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 wui5 hai2 gim2 caa4 zaam6 gim2 caa4 so2 jau5 ce1 loeng2

rows.note: Use 媒介 for a medium or channel through which talent or views are expressed.

example.english: This platform is an important vehicle for showcasing the talent of local artists.
example.traditional: 呢個平台係展示本地藝術家才華嘅重要媒介。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 ping4 toi4 hai6 zin2 si6 bun2 dei6 ngai6 seot6 gaa1 coi4 waa4 ge3 zung6 jiu3 mui4 gaai3
